title: Add titles to widgets' images on examples page
body:
Unless you are familiar with the icons of each widget, the current images are hard to understand. I added the title so you at least get a tooltip - making it easier to find the widget in the doc afterwards.

_Also, I'm not really sure about the syntax and didn't want to deploy everything to test, so tell me if I should make some changes._

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @vvo, @Shipow and @redox to be potential reviewers

If you want to make the update a breeze:
- name your commit docs(examples): add titles on widget icons (do changes, then git commit -a --amend)
- submit PR to master branch
- once we merge on master, website will be updated automatically in minutes
Need to explain some git easy contribution flow soon so that it's easier to contribute here for more people
